issue.title: [Bug]: Configure expected console baudrate from inventory files

failure.body:
### Issue Description

dut_console/test_console_baud_rate uses hardcoded baudrate expectations in the test case, with currently the only supported baudrate being 9600. New platforms with different baudrates need to be explicitly specified in the test case.
This PR enhances the test case to look at the inventory files / host vars for this value rather than needing to update the testcase for platforms that dont use the default. If the value does not exist in the inventory, then it will default to 9600.

### Results you see

console baudrate tests fail for platforms which use different baudrates than 9600, with the testcase needing to be updated to support them.

### Results you expected to see

baudrate expectations should be configurable via inventory files.

### Is it platform specific

generic
